g.text: This board is meant to provide a few key properties to the board:

g.desc: This board is meant to provide a few key properties to the board:

g.text: 1: Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) to track and maintain optimal charging speed from solar panels

g.desc: 1: Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) to track and maintain optimal charging speed from solar panels

g.text: 2: 3V3 and 5V lines to provide power to ADCS, OBC, and (possibly) comms

g.desc: 2: 3V3 and 5V lines to provide power to ADCS, OBC, and (possibly) comms

g.text: 3: Telemetry and fault detection which is processed by the onboard MCU and sent to OBC for interpretation over CAN

g.desc: 3: Telemetry and fault detection which is processed by the onboard MCU and sent to OBC for interpretation over CAN
